name: Phenacemide
summary: Phenacemide (INN, BAN) (brand name Phenurone), also known as phenylacetylurea, is an anticonvulsant of the ureide (acetylurea) class. It is a congener and ring-opened analogue of phenytoin (a hydantoin), and is structurally related to the barbiturates and to other hydantoins. Phenacemide was introduced in 1949 for the treatment of epilepsy, but was eventually withdrawn due to toxicity.

uses.text: Phenacemide was introduced in 1949 for the treatment of epilepsy, but was eventually withdrawn due to toxicity.

summaryZh: 苯乙醯脲（英語：Phenacemide），分子式C9H10N2O2，是一種醯基脲類抗驚厥藥。
summaryZhHans: 苯乙酰脲（英语：Phenacemide），分子式C9H10N2O2，是一种酰基脲类抗惊厥药。

pharmacology.en: It raises the threshold at which a seizure starts. How it does this is not fully understood.
pharmacology.zh: 它會提高癲癇發作的閾值，至於具體機制則尚未完全清楚。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它会提高癫痫发作的阈值，至于具体机制则尚未完全清楚。

sideEffects.en: It caused liver damage, damage to the bone marrow with falls in blood cell counts, kidney problems and psychiatric disturbance, which is why it fell out of use.
sideEffects.zh: 它曾造成肝損傷、骨髓損傷伴隨血球數下降、腎臟問題與精神症狀，這也是它後來不再使用的原因。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它曾造成肝损伤、骨髓损伤伴随血球数下降、肾脏问题与精神症状，这也是它后来不再使用的原因。

fact.en: It is phenytoin with its ring opened up, and it was introduced in 1949. It was effective against hard to treat seizures but was abandoned because of its toxicity.
fact.zh: 它是把苯妥英的環打開後的結構，於 1949 年問世。它對難治型癲癇有效，但因毒性而被棄用。
fact.zhHans: 它是把苯妥英的环打开后的结构，于 1949 年问世。它对难治型癫痫有效，但因毒性而被弃用。
